question: Sangeet Natak Akademi Award winner Deepak Mazumdar is an exponent of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Deepak Mazumdar** is a renowned exponent of **Bharatanatyam**, one of the classical dance forms of India.
 
• He has been honored with the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for his contributions to this dance form.
